scripts.wp:plugin-check: docker compose run --rm wpcli wp plugin check webmcp-canary --include-experimental --include-low-severity-errors --include-low-severity-warnings
scripts.cf:kv:create: npx wrangler@latest kv namespace create WEBMCP_KV
scripts.d1:migrate:local: npx wrangler@latest d1 migrations apply webmcp-canary --local
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: npx wrangler@latest d1 migrations apply webmcp-canary --remote
scripts.test:deploy-gate: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:webmcp-headless && npm run test:mcp-regression
